response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems experience with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks direct executive leadership in fintech or agentic AI at scale. His technical breadth and open-source contributions are impressive, yet the role requires deeper specialization in regulated AI-native fintech systems and proven CTO-level team scaling.
strengths: Extensive full-stack and distributed systems experience, including low-latency microservices and event-driven architectures.
Hands-on contributions to AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators) and open-source projects like GISCollective.
Strong track record in technical leadership roles, including mentoring, tooling development, and cross-functional collaboration.
concerns: No explicit experience operating AI systems in regulated fintech environments with financial consequences.
Lacks demonstrated CTO-level responsibility scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ people in high-growth companies.
Agentic AI experience appears limited to tooling/frameworks rather than production multi-agent systems with real-time decisioning.
